newsitem.title: USA: LA-Z-Boy encouraged by Q3 sales.
newsitem.headline: LA-Z-Boy encouraged by Q3 sales.

text.p: LA-Z-Boy Inc said its sales for the January 25 third quarter were higher than its earlier expectations, giving the company encouragement that fourth quarter sales could match the year-to-date increase.
For the quarter, sales rose to $244.6 million from $226.4 million a year earlier. For the nine months, they advanced to $718.4 million from $680.4 million.
Quarterly earnings rose to $0.54 a share from $0.42.

The company said due to stock buybacks exceeding issuances of stock, the number of shares outstanding continued to decline at the end of the quarter. Outstanding shares were 17,961,000 at January 1, 1997. They were 18,135,000 at October 1996, it said.
